claims.text: Measles: age-based vit A, ≥ 12 mo 200,000 IU; 6 to 11 mo 100,000 IU; < 6 mo 50,000 IU, orally once a day for 2 days, a third dose ≥ 2 wks later.
claims.quote: Doses are age-based: ≥ 12 months (including adults): 200,000 IU (60,000 mcg RAE) 6 to 11 months: 100,000 IU (30,000 mcg RAE) < 6 months: 50,000 IU (15,000 mcg RAE) The dose is given orally once a day for 2 days, with a third dose at least 2 weeks later.

claims.text: Prolonged daily lrg doses, esp in infants, must be avoided (toxicity).
claims.quote: Prolonged daily administration of large doses, especially to infants, must be avoided because toxicity may result
